capabilities: Open the DSH chat panel in an Obsidian sidebar
Send the current note to DSH and write results back to the vault
Switch AI models and execution permissions (queue/steer)
Auto-detect, launch, and install the local DSH service
Create, switch, and browse DSH chat sessions with streaming replies
disambiguation: Not an AI engine itself; it is only an interface that requires a separately installed local DeepSeek Harness instance.
extras: The manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' warning; installation is manual file placement or via BRAT, with detailed step-by-step instructions. README is in Chinese. Privacy note: connects only to 127.0.0.1, no third-party data sent.
problem: Using the DSH agent requires switching to a browser or desktop app instead of working inside Obsidian's sidebar.

relations.evidence: 把 DSH 的智能体对话、代码执行、文档检索能力嵌进你的笔记工作流

requires.name: DeepSeek Harness (desktop app or dsh web CLI)

summary: Sidebar panel that runs the local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI inside Obsidian, bridging notes to AI agent chats and managing the local DSH service.
